tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List supported brands, manual types and workflow. Public catalogue data only.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Find model candidates by model designation, optionally exact brand. Return ambiguity instead of guessing. chassis_reference is an exact catalogue reference, NOT an arbitrary VIN. Select the correct model_id with the user before searching manuals.

tools.name: find_manuals
tools.description: Find public PDF product listings by chosen model_id or exact SKU. Optional language (BCP47), type U/operator, W/workshop, M/maintenance, P/parts. Pagination uses next_after_id. Returns shop links, never paid PDF downloads. Empty results do not prove no suitable manual exists.

tools.name: get_manual
tools.description: Read public product facts and explicitly assigned compatible model categories. Never guarantees VIN compatibility. No checkout, purchase or file access.
